name: HolyMind — Edited Journey
reason: Owner feedback: repeated design and too much default reading make the lower showcase hard to reach. Editorial refinement rather than adding another effect or section.

changes.hero_and_orbit: Remove the duplicate three-principle strip under the Hero. Keep the original brain and moving Reason/Build/Verify orbit, but reduce each chapter to a concise statement and remove repetitive jump links.
changes.assembly: Keep native pin, the same slow-normal-slow easing, complete 0–100 before moving onward and full reverse. Shorter scroll span: 1.35 mobile / 1.55 desktop viewport heights, bounded 800–1600 CSS px.
changes.workbench: Compact horizontal mobile challenge rail. Main route keeps stage controls and live illustrative diagram. Scenario paragraph, step rationale, guardrail and measurement text move into one native Thinking & guardrails disclosure; none of those functional explanations is deleted.
changes.skills: Keep the six-skill optical fan visible. Full searchable/filterable 34-skill library is closed by default and opens with keyboard or pointer. Its visible summary owns the gallery continuity/audio anchor; hidden card positions are never used for the main route. Close restores the short route and summary focus.
changes.services: Replace oversized repeated service doors with compact typographic rows. All three service descriptions remain available on explicit open, initially closed.
changes.about_and_contact: Keep Boom/firework stage and overhead space. Longer Thai/identity copy remains inside the existing About disclosure. Original portal, chosen-intent brief and editing/copy controls retained. A mobile-menu contact link is available without restoring Hero jump buttons.

measurement_method: Fresh WebKit contexts, no stored choices, default closed disclosures, same viewport and font-ready wait. Document pixel height includes the native assembly pin spacer. Main word count uses main.innerText split on whitespace; it is not a reading-time estimate.
preserved: Original pixel-neon artwork and all source images
Five alternating fireworks with 259 fixed particle identities
Long recorded final burst 3.7 seconds and glitter 4.2 seconds
Mozart note order, natural ringing tails and four independent sound roles
v26 piano continuity through mobile-height changes after fireworks
Keyboard controls, native disclosures and no-JavaScript rationale
coverage: Default and expanded library, all 34 skills, filtering/empty/reset, 3 scenarios, proof exclusion, copy/return/reset, service and bio disclosures, 0–100–0 assembly, all eleven visual/audio route stations, particle reversal, 320–1440 layouts, physical-size-change simulation and native touch emulation with measured piano output after fireworks.

limitations.note: Measurements compare default unopened content at fixed emulated viewports. Opening optional depth intentionally lengthens the page. Browser/native-touch automation is not a physical iPhone listening or frame-rate test.
